set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- A calm-host JVM and full-linked Node baseline is pinned to the candidate commit.
- JDK 21 ARM64 and x86-64 evidence covers canonical, offset-contiguous, broadcast, sliced, reversed, transposed, rank-three, and rank-four workloads.
- Exact semantic and layout signatures remain green.
- Built-in primitive hot loops have no per-element boxing or generic callback dispatch.
- Eager operations allocate only documented results plus bounded metadata.
- Any Into or prepared API promised for 1.0 has constant per-run allocation.
- Every visible regression is reported; missed targets receive an explicit accept, defer, or reject decision rather than disappearing from aggregates.
set.title: Ratify the core 1.0 performance and allocation floor
